archetype: High Density Studio IDE / Dev Tool (Figma / Linear / Vercel Aesthetic)

typography.font_family_display: JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace
typography.font_family_sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-md (4px to 6px max for professional IDE feel)
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for panels, shadow-xl for floating inspector & modals, no harsh glowing neon
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#11131a]/90 border border-[#1e2230] for headers, overlays and Cmd+K palette
visual_enhancers.micro_textures: subtle grid lines on simulation charts, crisp 1px hairlines, monochrome status dot indicators
visual_enhancers.card_preview_rendering: restrained digital card frame with crystal-clear stat badges, rarity band, mana cost gem, and effect syntax highlighter

layout_and_grids.sidebar_width: w-64 fixed left navigation panel with studio brand, workspace selector, version badge, and section list
layout_and_grids.context_bar_height: h-12 sticky top bar with active section title, breadcrumb, global search button (Cmd+K), version switcher, quick export trigger, and autosave indicator
layout_and_grids.card_library_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4
layout_and_grids.card_inspector: w-[440px] fixed right-0 top-0 bottom-0 z-40 bg-[#11131a] border-l border-[#1e2230] shadow-2xl overflow-y-auto p-6
layout_and_grids.simulation_dashboard: grid grid-cols-12 gap-6 with left 4-col config panel, center 5-col chart stats, right 3-col matchup matrix
layout_and_grids.balance_dashboard: grid grid-cols-12 gap-6 with top KPI cards, 8-col anomaly table, 4-col side-by-side version comparison panel

motion.slide_over: framer-motion initial={{ x: '100%' }} animate={{ x: 0 }} exit={{ x: '100%' }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
motion.progress_bar: smooth animated progress fill during simulation runs (300ms step updates)

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for body and data text, high contrast mono metrics
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard access: Cmd+K for command palette, Esc to close slide-over / modals, arrow keys for card navigation
accessibility.aria_attributes: aria-expanded on collapse panels, role='dialog' on CommandPalette and GodotExportModal, data-testid on every interactive element

instructions_to_main_agent.app_shell: Build a cohesive, fixed desktop IDE layout with left sidebar, top context bar, persistent bottom console status bar, and floating action button for Godot Export.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_mocking: Provide a rich set of 25+ default Card Dual cards across 4 factions (Shadow, Ember, Tech, Arcane), 5 rarities (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic), full effect scripts, status states, power scores, and simulated win rates.
instructions_to_main_agent.command_palette: Implement Cmd+K command palette trigger globally so user can jump between cards, tools, run simulations, and trigger GDScript export.
instructions_to_main_agent.godot_exporter: Provide full Godot 4 GDScript generation with syntax highlight, copy to clipboard, and code download options for GDScript card data structure.
instructions_to_main_agent.balance_engine: Include simulated statistical balance checks, anomaly detection (cards with >58% win rate highlighted amber/red), confidence interval calculations, and version comparison.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, create distinct, professional IDE frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as loud full-screen gradients.
Create depth through layered panels with 1px border hierarchy (#1e2230 and #2a3044).
Never center-align the app container. Maintain left-aligned, structured studio layout.
DO NOT use transparent background in overlays, dropdowns, headers, or floating inspectors.
All key interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='card-search-input', data-testid='run-sim-btn', data-testid='export-godot-btn').
Use sonner for toast notifications on autosave, card creation, simulation completion, and GDScript code copying.
